newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bunker market weaker amid good supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bunker market weaker amid good supply.

text.p: North American bunker prices were weaker in light trade this week amid good supply conditions and low prices abroad, players said on Tuesday.
A sharp drop in NYMEX crude and heating oil futures Tuesday also helped put some downward pressure on the market.
In the East Coast, New York Harbor 380 CST dropped $3 a tonne to between $97 a tonne and $98 a tonne. 180 CST was pegged $102/103 a tonne.
Houston 380 CST on the Gulf Coast was also a tad weaker, trading $1 a tonne below last Thursday at $94/95 a tonne.
"There is not much demand right now and supply is pretty good overall," said a trader in Houston.
Seattle also pointed lower for the week, at $94/95 for 380 CST and $100/101 for 180 CST a tonne.
